questions.question: What sign did Isaiah give to King Ahaz?
options: A prophet much like Moses shall one day come up from your own people
A green branch shall grow up out of the dry stump of Jesse the father
A virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and call his name Immanuel
A bright star shall rise up out of Jacob to rule over all the nations
questions.answer: A virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and call his name Immanuel

questions.question: What did Isaiah urge Ahaz to do in the face of the threat from Syria and Israel?
options: Flee away from the city and go hide himself up in the hills
Be careful, be quiet, and not fear; stand firm in faith
Gather together the whole army and march out to battle
Make a binding treaty with Assyria in return for protection
questions.answer: Be careful, be quiet, and not fear; stand firm in faith

questions.question: The name Immanuel means 'God with us.'
Behold, the virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and shall call his name _____.
